translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
translations.en.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest,
translations.en.yusufali: And by the Night when it is still,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan demi malam apabila telah sunyi (gelap),

transliteration: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa

translations.en.sahih: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
translations.en.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
translations.en.yusufali: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhanmu tiada meninggalkan kamu dan tiada (pula) benci kepadamu.

translations.en.sahih: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
translations.en.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
translations.en.yusufali: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya hari kemudian itu lebih baik bagimu daripada yang sekarang (permulaan).

transliteration: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda

translations.en.sahih: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
translations.en.yusufali: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kelak Tuhanmu pasti memberikan karunia-Nya kepadamu, lalu (hati) kamu menjadi puas.

transliteration: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa

translations.en.sahih: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
translations.en.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
translations.en.yusufali: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Dia mendapatimu sebagai seorang yatim, lalu Dia melindungimu?

transliteration: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada

translations.en.sahih: And He found you lost and guided [you],
translations.en.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
translations.en.yusufali: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dia mendapatimu sebagai seorang yang bingung, lalu Dia memberikan petunjuk.

translations.en.sahih: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
translations.en.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
translations.en.yusufali: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dia mendapatimu sebagai seorang yang kekurangan, lalu Dia memberikan kecukupan.

transliteration: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar

translations.en.sahih: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
translations.id.indonesian: Sebab itu, terhadap anak yatim janganlah kamu berlaku sewenang-wenang.

transliteration: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar

translations.en.sahih: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan terhadap orang yang minta-minta, janganlah kamu menghardiknya.

transliteration: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith

translations.en.sahih: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
translations.en.yusufali: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan terhadap nikmat Tuhanmu, maka hendaklah kamu siarkan.
